newsitem.title: USA: Network General up after product comments.
newsitem.headline: Network General up after product comments.

text.p: Shares of Network General Corp rose 2-1/2 to 20-1/8 after the company said a new product should help rather than hurt earnings.
The company said analysts and investors had feared that a new product release, slated for next week, would be a transition product for the company.

"We have a new architecture that we're releasing a new product under next week at InterOp and I think there was some confusion with respect to its being a product transition," said Lesley Matlos, head of investor relations at Network General.
The product, yet to be named, will be unveiled at the Network World/InterOp trade show in Atlanta on Wednesday next week.
"It will be a positive effect (on earnings) when it starts shipping," Matlos said.

"It is not a product transition. There was some concern in the market that we may hit a wall here if it was a transition. It is not. It is additive. It is incremental to our existing product line," she said.
